Subject: Re: FB/USAID -COVID response discussion
Dear Madhu and Rajat,
Hope you are doing well.
Specific to our conversations on the work Facebook has been doing around COVID related communications, I would
like to connect you to our Implementing Partner for the REVIVE program. Priya leads Samhita Collective Good
Foundation and through the platform called India Protectors Alliance working on vaccine-related awareness,
sensitization, COVID appropriate behavior, vaccine hesitancy etc. One of the corporate partners under the alliance is
HUL which in turn is working with UNICEF around behavioral changecommunication tools targeting COVID.
Connecting the dots to explore further collaborations.
Regards
Satish
USAID/India
